news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.0x net interest cover). news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.42 (vs ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.42 (up from ₹0.09 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹186.6m (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹9.82m (up 363% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.3% (up from 1.3% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 48% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 111% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Investor sentiment deteriorates as stock falls 17%
news.body: After last week's 17% share price decline to ₹120, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 30.2x. Average trailing P/E is 28x in the Basic Materials industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 666% over the past three years.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.08 (vs ₹0.06 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.08 (up from ₹0.06 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹256.8m (up 138% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹25.4m (up ₹24.0m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 9.9% (up from 1.3% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 111% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
